source: Li et al JGR 2021JB022905, Zenodo 5764145 v2
payload_boundary: A trusted extractor reads all pressure rows but only releases per dyadic-block DC means and lengths on 12 kg. Neither author filtered means nor held detail coefficients reach the producer. Only source spectra and condition-average optical secants enter calibration. Optical fields independently measured on incompletely paired replicates, not matched instantaneous inputs. Same permitted covariates for all roles.
segmentation: From sample 0 split native series into disjoint 64 samples, then greedily largest power of two to terminal singleton. For each group and s in 2,4,...64 use all disjoint orthonormal signed Haar coefficients H=(sum(first)-sum(last))/sqrt(s). Score mean H² over every coefficient at that scale. Every native sample retained, with tail-derived DC and detail census; Parseval checked on raw. Within each block, DC leaves length-1 dimensions unconstrained in the real data space. The dyadic tail includes smaller blocks and optional terminal singleton. For a smooth pulse near a block boundary the measured power can depend on grid phase. Epoch zero and the 64-sample partition stay fixed for all roles.
drivers: For each run and scale let L be mean of positive-part block DC weighted by count of coefficients at the scale; D2 analogously weights DC+ squared. Gamma is equal optical replicate mean of the time means of |u_top-u_bottom|/(h_top-h_bottom) from every available coordinate-pair row within the exact author-merged profile rectangle, including columns with leading blank cells and measured extrema in each profile; drop only profiles with fewer than 2 distinct heights. Refuse empty condition. This secant omits unobserved near-base gradients; not a measured impact speed. Unit Pa and s^-1. T=1550*(d40*Gamma)^2 Pa with d40 in metres. Paper maps normalized agitation to Ti^b, b in .31–.43 by mass. Finite-band analog uses D2*T^(2b); differs from original mean, dynamic density, time/endpoint and fitted exponents. No independent prediction from authors for this endpoint.
mechanism: For common pulse response and stationary independent marked impacts, a two-sided spectral density scales with rate times second impulse moment. Mean load scales with rate times first moment. At fixed composition/sensor, assuming proportional effective impulse with independently inferred shear gives predicted power proportional to L*Gamma. These are conditional finite-band surrogates for nonstationary, possibly correlated collisions plus enduring pressure; a positive result cannot identify independence/grain impact masses, electronics, or causation.
fit: For each composition and scale, positive feature models set a through-origin gain = mean development energy / mean development driver (equal weight for each 4/8-kg replicate). Candidate L*Gamma; shot L; coherent D2; published analog D2*T^(2b) with b=.37,.31,.43; cyclic sham takes Gamma from next composition in same mass. Source mean, 8-kg average, linear released mass driver and clipped 2*8mean−4mean extrapolation separately. Learned load exponent is pooled within-composition OLS logQ on logL demeaned by composition, clipped [-2,4] and a fitted composition gain. Joint log ridge pools within-composition centered logL, logGamma and log(mass), ridge penalty 1 on standardized columns (each unit RMS across training); intercept per composition, no source tuning. All logs use positive source/allowed inputs else refuse.
evaluation: Report every run/scale/role, Pa² residuals and original 13 target vectors. Divide errors by training mean power of same composition/scale. Per-run root mean square of six normalized errors and normalized mean absolute error; equal-weighted mean over runs per composition and then equal five compositions. Gate: candidate strictly lower on both pooled metrics than every other method and lower within-composition normalized RMSE on at least three of five against each. No exclusions or tuning. Preserve maximum absolute and normalized errors and their raw signed Haar segments alongside every role at same cell. Scores condition on the held coarse pressure and separate optical coverage; this is not a force prediction from released mass alone.
optical_read_before_stress: All 384 dated optical secants across 26 recorded optical replicates and 15 conditions were qualified before any 12 kg detail calculation. The first optical-only parser incorrectly treated leading blanks as profile endings; original retained. All 32 development and 13 held pressure identities fixed before optical values.
